subject.title: feat: keep reset session history searchable

question: Should explicit reset retain prior SQLite generations until physical disk pressure, with `resetArchiveRetention` applying only to extracted archive artifacts rather than retained database history?
rationale: This is a persistent session-lifecycle and existing-maintenance-setting semantic change; tests can verify mechanics but cannot determine the intended long-term user and upgrade contract.

options.title: Adopt durable reset history
options.body: Approve searchable reset generations until physical budget reclamation, then require a rebased head and real runtime proof of reset searchability and safe pressure eviction.

options.title: Preserve retention expiry semantics
options.body: Retain an age-based expiry for reset generations, which requires a deliberate persistent retirement marker, migration approach, and explicit SQLite schema decision.

recommendation.title: Adopt durable reset history
recommendation.body: Approve searchable reset generations until physical budget reclamation, then require a rebased head and real runtime proof of reset searchability and safe pressure eviction.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged and proposed work establishes the most direct available history connection to the reset-policy and session-lifecycle direction.
